rationale: With only 20 minutes to close, the last five 1-minute candles show decelerating momentum — price has drifted from $34.56 down to $34.50 on sharply declining volume (34K to ~6K), suggesting the intraday move is exhausting near the day's high. The stock is already at 84.6% of its range with price below the 9-EMA ($34.54), offering no clean directional edge; a long risks being caught in end-of-day profit-taking while a short faces forced liquidation risk against a stock that has already run ~4% today. The risk/reward in either direction over a 20-minute window with this setup does not justify the spread and execution risk.
